zip_code=int(zip_code_str)

addresses = apis.amazon.show_addresses(access_token=am_token)
address_match=None
for a in addresses:
    if int(a['zip_code'])==zip_code and a['street_address'].strip().lower()==street_address.strip().lower():
        address_match=a
        break
if not address_match:
    raise Exception('No matching address found')
address_id = address_match['address_id']

# Pick non-expired card
now = apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time()
import re, datetime
m = re.search(r'([A-Za-z]+)\s+(\d{1,2}),\s+(\d{4})', now['date'])
month = datetime.datetime.strptime(m.group(1), '%B').month
year = int(m.group(3))

cards = apis.amazon.show_payment_cards(access_token=am_token)
valid_cards=[]
for c in cards:
    if c['expiry_year']>year or (c['expiry_year']==year and c['expiry_month']>=month):
        valid_cards.append(c)
pick_cards = valid_cards if valid_cards else cards
payment_card_id = pick_cards[0]['payment_card_id']
print('address_id', address_id, 'payment_card_id', payment_card_id)

order = apis.amazon.place_order(payment_card_id=payment_card_id, address_id=address_id, access_token=am_token)
